claim: Framework-policy position documents live in this repo (positions/): cb: beliefs ground in repo-relative document: URIs, and a distributable framework must resolve every artifact its own graph cites. The homing boundary is unchanged - claims about CB-the-system land in cb:, claims about the world or mission land in collections.

evidence.detail: User decision in the wrap-up-to-stasis discussion (the design intention and policy of the system should live within the system), sharpened by the distro-resolvability argument: a cb: node citing a document in a sibling repo points across a boundary the standalone distro does not ship. Precedent: positions/2026-06-10-code-as-operational-substrate.md -> b484-b488.
